sentence: This project studies how the cellular response to chromatin architectural defects works against age-associated chromatin changes.
This project studies how pancreatic cancer cells adapt to stress and evade the immune system, which drives resistance to treatment.
This project studies how excessive ethanol exposure affects epigenetic mechanisms in the neuroimmune system, using CRISPR and high-throughput sequencing.
This project develops and tests therapies for acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome.
This project studies how alcohol exposure during the last trimester of pregnancy in rodents changes the brain system that integrates and redistributes memories.
This project builds prediction models and a conversation aid to guide obesity treatment choices using real world data.
This project studies how the stiffness of the surrounding environment helps oral squamous cell carcinoma cells acquire metastatic behaviors that promote invasion of adjacent tissues.
This project builds software tools and deep learning models that identify proteoforms using top-down mass spectrometry and spectral library search.
This project studies how sensory neurons in tumors and tumor-draining lymph nodes hold back the immune response against cancer.
This project studies the T cells in the heart during cardiac sarcoidosis and tests whether blocking a receptor can reduce cardiac inflammation.
This project studies what microglia do in response to plaques in Alzheimer's disease and whether that response is beneficial or detrimental.
This project builds biosensors and agents seen with MRI to prevent and repair brain injury caused by radiotherapy in pediatric brain tumor survivors.
This project studies genetic mutations and their effects in the lung of patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
This project studies how natural selection and population structure shape human genomic variation and confound studies of the genetic basis of disease.
This project studies endolysosomal mechanisms in Christianson Syndrome and childhood developmental and neurodegenerative disease.
This project builds a shared service that collects, stores and provides human samples and offers bioanalytical assays and biostatistics support for obesity research.
This project studies how T follicular regulatory cells fight tumors and tests ways to target them more specifically in cancer immunotherapy.
This project tries to find out whether an E3 ubiquitin ligase can keep T cells from becoming exhausted and control solid tumor growth.
